title: Surabaya Marathon 2026 Review: East Java's Capital-City Full Marathon
seo_title: Surabaya Marathon 2026 Review | East Java Indonesia Race
meta_description: The Surabaya Marathon 2026: August 2 at Parkir Timur Plaza Surabaya. 42K, 21K, 10K, 5K in Indonesia's City of Heroes — registration details reviewed.
dek: Set for 2 August 2026 at Parkir Timur Plaza Surabaya, this East Java capital-city marathon offers four distances. Registration details inside — here's what to expect from Indonesia's second-city road race.
verdict: The Surabaya Marathon brings a full 42.195km to Indonesia's City of Heroes — the country's second-largest metropolitan area and a major running hub. Four distances (42K, 21K, 10K, 5K) anchored at Parkir Timur Plaza Surabaya, a central city venue with good transport links. Surabaya has a passionate running community and wide city roads that support a full marathon course. August is the dry season in East Java — warm but manageable with an early-morning start. A solid Indonesian city marathon for runners wanting to experience the country beyond Jakarta and Bali.
